title: Introducing a New Colleague
paragraphs: Pada hari pertamanya di kantor, Farhan terlihat gugup berdiri di dekat meja resepsionis, tidak yakin harus ke mana atau bertanya kepada siapa untuk arah menuju lantai timnya yang baru.
Maya, yang sedang berjalan lewat dengan kopinya, menyadari keraguannya dan berhenti. "Kamu pasti orang baru di sini. Saya Maya, dari tim pemasaran," katanya sambil tersenyum ramah.
Farhan memperkenalkan diri dengan penuh syukur, lega karena ada yang memperhatikannya. Maya menawarkan untuk mengantarnya ke mejanya karena itu searah dengannya.
Sepanjang jalan, ia menunjukkan ruang shalat, pantry, dan ruang rapat yang mungkin akan ia butuhkan selama minggu pertamanya. Detail kecil, tapi sungguh-sungguh berguna.
Saat mereka tiba di mejanya, Farhan sudah merasa sedikit kurang cemas untuk memulai pekerjaan baru di tempat yang asing. Jalan kaki singkat itu membuat perbedaan yang nyata.
answerKey: On his first day at the office, Farhan looked visibly nervous standing near the reception desk, unsure where to go or who to ask for directions to his new team's floor. Maya, who was walking past with her coffee, noticed his hesitation and stopped. "You must be new here. I am Maya, from the marketing team," she said with a friendly smile. Farhan introduced himself gratefully, relieved that someone had noticed him. Maya offered to walk him to his desk since it was on her way anyway. Along the way, she pointed out the prayer room, the pantry, and the meeting rooms he would likely need during his first week. Small details, but genuinely useful ones. By the time they reached his desk, Farhan already felt slightly less anxious about starting a new job in an unfamiliar place. A short walk had made a real difference.
